Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/php-src && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/empty_pattern.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"mb_ereg_search_init","code":"mb_ereg_search_init(\"\",\"\",\"\");","note":"The search API is invoked with empty attacker-controlled inputs, forcing the mbregex code into its empty-pattern handling path."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/empty_pattern.phpt","function":"<global>","line":12,"var":"mb_split","code":"mb_split(\"\",\"\");","note":"A second regex API call immediately follows, exercising shared mbstring regex state after the empty-pattern path."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/empty_pattern.phpt","function":"<global>","line":13,"var":"mb_ereg_search_regs","code":"mb_ereg_search_regs();","note":"The search API then reads the shared state, which can expose stale or freed regex objects if cleanup is incorrect."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":0,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"mb_ereg_search_init stores the compiled regex in the global search_re slot","note":"This shared slot is the vulnerable object whose lifetime is reused across mbstring regex APIs."},
{"step":5,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_split)","line":0,"var":"re","code":"if ((re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, MBREX(regex_default_options), MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax))) == NULL) { RETURN_FALSE; }","note":"A second compilation path can allocate and free regex objects while the search state still points at prior data."},
{"step":6,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_regs)","line":0,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (MBREX(search_re) == NULL) { php_error_docref(NULL, E_WARNING, \"No regex given\"); RETURN_FALSE; }","note":"The search API dereferences the shared regex state after it may have been freed or replaced."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_regs)","line":0,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"if (MBREX(search_regs) != NULL) { onig_region_free(MBREX(search_regs), 1); }","note":"The region object is explicitly freed and recreated, so stale references can become dangling if other code still uses them."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1551,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax);","note":"Compilation of a new pattern can replace the shared regex object and trigger the lifetime bug."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The stale or replaced regex object is then used by the search engine, which is the memory-safety sink."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
